content.value: Determine the maximum deflection for the beam loaded as shown in figure below. The allowable deflection for the beam is 20 mm. Is the given beam section sufficient to control the allowable deflection? If not, what would be the probable solutions to control excessive deflection of the beam at the given loading and support conditions? Consider, E = 9 GPa. Use double-integration method to calculate the deflection of the beam.
